name: manchester-tonight
description: What's on in Manchester tonight: pub quizzes, comedy, open mics, live music, club nights, drag and happy hours, with times, venues and links.

interface.longDescription:
Manchester Tonight is an independent guide to nights out in Manchester, UK. Ask what's on and get real listings: pub quizzes, comedy, open mics, live music, club nights, drag and happy hours across the city centre, Northern Quarter, Didsbury, Chorlton, Stockport, Salford and more, plus one-off gigs and seasonal events like Halloween, Bonfire Night and Christmas markets.

Ask by date ("tonight", "Saturday", "31/10/2026"), area, type or keyword, or look up a single venue. Every result has a time, venue, area and a link back to the listing, and shows when it was last checked.

It can also turn the nights you pick into a plan link to send your friends on WhatsApp.

No account needed. Listings are read-only; the only thing saved is a night-out plan you ask it to make, kept just to serve its short link until a month after the plan's last day.
capabilities: Find nights out by date, area and type
defaultPrompt: Any comedy in the Northern Quarter on Saturday?
Which pubs in Didsbury do a quiz?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists tonight's nights out in Manchester (UK time) with time, venue, area and a manchestertonight.co.uk link for each.

positive.prompt: Which pubs in Didsbury do a pub quiz?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists quiz nights in Didsbury with the day they run (e.g. Every Wednesday), time and link.

positive.prompt: What Christmas markets and festive events are on in Manchester?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming dated Christmas events with dates, times, prices where known and a ticket or details link.
Shows Frog & Bucket's regular comedy nights and any upcoming one-off shows, with its address area, sources and last-checked date.

positive.prompt: Plan me a Saturday night in the Northern Quarter with a quiz then comedy, and give me something to send my mates.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a quiz and a comedy night in the Northern Quarter on Saturday, agrees them, then returns a manchestertonight.co.uk plan link with the stops, times and a message to send.
